stem:
Yash fixes four wax pins — P, Q, R and S — along a copper strip. Pin P is nearest the heated end. Pin S is farthest. He heats that end of the strip.

In which order do the pins fall?

options.text: All four pins fall at the same time.
S, then R, then Q, then P.
P, then Q, then R, then S.
Only P falls; Q, R and S stay attached.

teacher.key_rationale: Heat conducts from the hot end along the strip, so pins fall from nearest to farthest.
